models.name: Kimi K2 Thinking
models.variant: thinking agent, INT4 QAT weights (all benchmark results reported under INT4 precision); Heavy Mode = 8 parallel trajectories + reflective aggregation
models.capability_summary: 月之暗面将 Kimi K2 Thinking 定位为思考型智能体（thinking agent），通过同时扩展思考 token 与工具调用步数推进测试时扩展前沿，可跨数百步规划、推理、执行与调整，全部评测结果以 INT4 QAT 精度报告。已收录评测覆盖通用推理、数学、智能体检索、编码与终端等领域，HLE 带工具 44.9（Heavy Mode 51.0）、SWE-bench Verified 71.3。

notes: Release date: kimi.ai official blog index lists 'Kimi K2 Thinking | 2025-11-06'; HuggingFace moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking createdAt 2025-11-04T08:25:31Z (weights uploaded two days before the blog post). The 'Full Evaluations [2]' section is a machine-readable DOM table; all 27 rows verified. Global protocol from footnotes: temperature=1.0 and 256k context for all K2 Thinking benchmarks except SciCode (official 0.0); all results under INT4 precision (QAT post-training). Thinking-token budgets: 96k for HLE-no-tools/AIME25/HMMT25/GPQA; 128k for IMO-AnswerBench/LiveCodeBench/OJ-Bench; 32k completion budget for Longform Writing. Aggregation: avg@32 (AIME/HMMT no tools), avg@16 (w/ python), avg@8 (IMO-AnswerBench), avg@4 (BrowseComp-ZH/Seal-0/FinSearchComp-T3), mean over 5 runs (all coding). HLE w/tools judge = o3-mini with official prompts; HLE step limit 120 with 48k reasoning budget per step; agentic-search limit 300 steps with 24k per step; context management hides previous tool outputs beyond 256k. Contamination disclosure: HuggingFace blocked during testing (51.3 on HLE without blocking). Asterisked competitor cells = re-tested by Kimi under the same conditions (footnote 3a); unmarked competitor cells quoted from official posts/leaderboards (GPT-5 reasoning effort set to high). Heavy Mode = 8 parallel trajectories + reflective aggregation; GPT-5 'heavy' column denotes official GPT-5 Pro score. Chat-mode caveat (footnote 1): kimi.com chat uses a tool subset and reduced turns, so chat results may not reproduce these scores.
